zones.D3: Oasis Reach and the White Pan

sites.name: the Waystation of the First Hour
the Great Shrine of the Hours

spots.title: The Ship in the Dune
spots.lore: Under the Sunwatch's sun disc, the sea people's god: a face with kelp for hair.

spots.title: The Navigator's Stones
spots.lore: The holder is a bronze ring for a disc of stone that sees the sun through cloud. Sun lines run from it to the horizon.

spots.title: The Gardener's Last Row
spots.lore: You can't move it far. Water finds the gap anyway, and the dead row drinks.

spots.title: The Measuring Wall
spots.verb: Pull the chisel from the groove

spots.title: The Sunken Greenhouse
spots.verb: Take a cutting of the living plant
spots.lore: Everything else in here is a brown stalk. This one found a crack of water.

spots.title: The Cartographer's Table
spots.verb: Take a rubbing of the map
spots.lore: The carved coast runs where the Pan is now. Waves are cut where you're standing.

spots.title: The Hands Wall
spots.verb: Take an ochre rubbing of the blue hands
spots.lore: Hundreds of ochre hands, old. One set small and blue, at child height, new.

spots.title: The Storm Tower
spots.lore: On the lee side, out of the sand: a slate of lens-grinding marks, the recipe for a stone that finds the sun.

spots.title: A sealed jar
spots.lore: Every other jar is dust. This one is full of dates, sweet as the day they were sealed.

spots.title: The Workshop of Faces
spots.lore: A face with no eye yet. The socket is the size of a man. You know this face: you have seen it on the Pan.

spots.title: The Weighing Room
spots.lore: The scale doesn't move when you take it. It was balanced against nothing.

spots.title: The Spring
spots.lore: Water rises clear out of the rock: the dead river's source, sealed under the sand.

spots.title: A bronze mirror on a pivot
A bronze mirror on a pivot
A bronze mirror on a pivot
A bronze mirror on a pivot
A dug pit and a carved lintel
spots.lore: The lintel's sun disc is the same as the gate's. Steps go down under the sand.

caches.title: The Tall Wreck's hold
caches.lore: Empty water casks, every bung knocked out. The labels match the camps' casks.

caches.title: A salt-cutter's sledge
caches.lore: A harness snapped clean through, dragged toward the dunes.

caches.title: A salt-crusted pack
caches.lore: Copper ingots under a skin of salt crystals, still in the dead Dromad's pack.

caches.title: The broken salt-caravan
caches.lore: The guards' spears still point outward.

caches.title: The burial niche
caches.lore: Gilt dust on the floor, and pup prints in it.

caches.title: A Dromad's load
caches.lore: Eight in a line, sunk to the neck. The ninth is a trough.

caches.title: A waystation larder
caches.lore: Stone benches face east. The water channel still trickles.

caches.title: A salt-cutter's niche
caches.lore: Tool marks in the salt, and a lens of crystal in the roof that throws a moving spot of sun.

caches.title: A miner's chest
caches.lore: A cage of bones where the Glasstails took the miners.

caches.title: The Last Caravan's strongbox
caches.lore: They roped their beasts in a ring and waited for a storm that never ended.

caches.title: A skiff's locker
caches.lore: Its sail is wrapped round a stela a kilometre from the sea.

caches.title: The Sun-Vault
caches.lore: A scarab of golden glass, the size of your palm.

caches.title: The Seventh Vault
caches.lore: A sun disc of beaten gold, the last king's, laid face down.
